data: Which line has the lowest accuracy at an edit distance of 25?

The question asks for the line with the lowest accuracy at an edit distance of 25. From the caption, we know that the x-axis represents the maximum edit distance difference and the y-axis represents the model accuracy. The lines in the graph represent different token transformer strategies: Insertion, Swapping, Substitution, and Deletion. At an edit distance of 25, the line representing Substitution appears to have the lowest accuracy among all the lines. Therefore, the answer is the Substitution line.
